# TotemEffect

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** TotemEffect

## What it does

TotemEffect draws a visual effect for the Totem of Undying. Like other effect modules such as JumpEffect and HitFX , it is purely cosmetic and does not change how the totem itself behaves.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/totemeffect). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
